rationale: Shirley bridges AI research and consumer product development (PM at Zoom, AI productivity tools), while Ahmad is architecting the next generation of AI-native hardware at Midjourney after leading Vision Pro's hardware engineering. They complement each other across the full stack—Shirley's ML research and TypeScript/Python foundation paired with Ahmad's expertise in spatial computing, hand-tracking, and deeply integrated AI hardware could unlock novel interface design for emerging form factors beyond traditional wearables.
intro_message: Shirley Li, meet Ahmad Abbas — Shirley's background in AI research and product tooling combined with Ahmad's vision for AI-native hardware form factors could spark ideas on how generative models integrate with novel interfaces.
